description: This file defines the 'HTML' controller class for the OpenCart admin module extension, handling CRUD operations and rendering views for a custom HTML module.

classes.name: HTML
classes.description: Controller class for managing a custom HTML module in OpenCart admin, including rendering the module page, saving data, adding, and deleting modules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the HTML module management page, setting up breadcrumbs, loading module info, and preparing data for the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the module configuration, validating permissions and input, and returning JSON response.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new HTML module with default name, validating permissions, and returning JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified module by ID, validating permissions, and returning JSON response.
